authority: current all-assest-rechecked-1.zip src_64; Pass353 only differential/mechanism oracle
global_rules: MID1 detail is a map keyed by decimal MID string; each embedded detail value has the same source-consumed schema as that MID handler, not an arbitrary placeholder.
Embedded MID1 hydration must be distinguished from later explicit network reloads in capture/differential logs.
Honest inactive stubs are allowed only when every source-dereferenced key/nesting/container/type remains present and internally coherent.

Boolean/integer/string distinctions are field-local and preserved exactly. In particular normal mail is_region must remain false/nil where source expects that meaning; numeric 0 is not a global boolean substitute.
Asynchronous MainScene fanout is checked by dependency/partial order, never one rigid packet sequence.

mid1_envelope.detail_contract: contains the 33 Pass408 hydration records keyed by tostring(mid); handler records with error_msg are skipped by stock and therefore cannot silently replace required baseline hydration.

critical_source_consumed_shapes.minimum: source Player/SelfPlayer populate contract; must include player_id, uid, region, lev/exp/economy/time/open-function/formation/avatar/guild fields needed by startup; no shapeless stub
critical_source_consumed_shapes.note: Pass353 response-key corpus is differential oracle only.
mail item field-local types remain source-specific; normal mail is_region false/nil, not numeric normalization.

critical_source_consumed_shapes.repeat: explicit MainScene reload after hydration is source-valid and must be idempotent/read-safe.

critical_source_consumed_shapes.inactive: guild_info absent/zero guild_id => stock sets guild_id=0

critical_source_consumed_shapes.strong_requirement: explicit getBuildingList dereferences cabinet_info.need_time/start_time/recent_complete_skill and building_list entries including key "1" plus ADMIN/BOARD/BOOKSHELF; a bare {} will crash/retrigger. Inactive fixture must provide coherent zero/idle building records.

critical_source_consumed_shapes.inactive: list=[] is the honest baseline if no startup activities are open.
signed fixture uses source-valid values; if is_signed==0 startup may legitimately send MID353 SIGN.

required.is_award: source scalar/container as consumed by album calculation

critical_source_consumed_shapes.failure_behavior: stock retries room discovery after ~5s on non-OK, so baseline must not intentionally return malformed/error responses.

critical_source_consumed_shapes.server_success: server sends CHAT_ROOM_ENTERED MID32779 for the same socket/room; that event clears the 10s connect timeout and starts heartbeat.

critical_source_consumed_shapes.required: source-compatible params may be empty if no consumer fields are required; MID itself is mandatory socket-admission acknowledgement.

critical_source_consumed_shapes.rule: server accepts without creating request storms; exact reply requirement remains Wave-B transport contract if source/socket library requires one.

critical_source_consumed_shapes.inactive: coherent closed/idle values, never missing paradise_info.
all list fields=[], counts=0; server_time must be authoritative epoch because client resets ServerTime from it.

critical_source_consumed_shapes.minimum: valid OK envelope; callback result is not consumed by this startup call.

critical_source_consumed_shapes.inactive: achieve_list=[] and coherent zero base_info fields used by red-mark/ranking logic.
pets=[]; stock creates collectedPets=[] even if pets absent, but explicit repeat should return stable source-shaped object.

critical_source_consumed_shapes.minimum: must be an object storable as practiceInfo; when practice function/awakened hero path is enabled, downstream practice UI/red-mark fields must follow owning source contract; do not return nil/shape-less error loop.

critical_source_consumed_shapes.rule: only applicable when source-valid LOAD_SIGN_INFO reports unsigned; response must satisfy sign_in window contract and settlement must be semantically replay-safe.

remaining_embedded_rule: For the other MID1 records not expanded above, Wave S binds each to its current src_64 handler schema and permits only source-shaped inactive values. Their deeper business semantics remain owned by later Design waves; shape compatibility is not permission to invent gameplay authority.
fixtures: S0-S3 from Pass408 remain normative; S1 specifically forces Guild/Pets/EventCentre/Practice paths. 60-second stable-lobby quiescence excludes expected heartbeat/legitimate timers and requires zero Lua exceptions/request storms.
scheduling: Live S0-S3 executes only after Design Waves A-D and foundational implementation exist, before deeper gameplay implementation. No design-time implementation exception was taken.
